objects.name: api_keys
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE api_keys (
	id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	user VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	key_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	prefix VARCHAR(12) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	revoked_at DATETIME, 
	last_used_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (key_hash)
)

objects.name: audit_log
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE audit_log (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	actor VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	action VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	document_id VARCHAR(32), 
	job_id VARCHAR(32), 
	ip VARCHAR(64), 
	outcome VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	detail VARCHAR(255), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

objects.name: check_run_documents
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE check_run_documents (
	run_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	document_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	role VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (run_id, document_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES check_runs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(document_id) REFERENCES documents (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

objects.name: check_runs
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE check_runs (
	id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	owner VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	"key" VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	params JSON NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	last_opened_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (owner, "key")
)

objects.name: documents
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE documents (
	id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	owner VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	display_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL, 
	size_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	page_count INTEGER, 
	status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	error TEXT, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	parsed_at DATETIME, 
	expires_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

objects.name: jobs
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE jobs (
	id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	document_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	owner VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	params JSON NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	progress INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	message TEXT, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	started_at DATETIME, 
	finished_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(document_id) REFERENCES documents (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

objects.name: ui_sessions
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE ui_sessions (
	id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	token_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	api_key_id VARCHAR(32), 
	user VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	expires_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	revoked_at DATETIME, 
	last_seen_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (token_hash), 
	FOREIGN KEY(api_key_id) REFERENCES api_keys (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

objects.name: audit_log_no_delete
objects.sql: CREATE TRIGGER audit_log_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON audit_log BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'audit_log is append-only'); END

objects.name: audit_log_no_update
objects.sql: CREATE TRIGGER audit_log_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON audit_log BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'audit_log is append-only'); END
